title: Brigade coupons
description: Redeemable codes that grant brigade credits, Roar coins (into the free wallet), or both. Each entry holds the SHA-256 of the code (trimmed, case-sensitive), never the code. Several entries may share one hash (one code, several grants): each is redeemed once per account on its own id. The SHIPPED table is empty (GH-1415): this repository is public, so a hash here is a public grant (an unsalted hash of a short code can be brute-forced offline, and the id replays in a claim). Tests inject their own table.
